name: Benchmark 1 — C forward-walking demo
purpose: First comparison benchmark for the new approach; preserve the user-preferred gait. Final objective remains omnidirectional sensor-based terrain locomotion for survey coverage.
method: Phase-guided reference position/velocity targets plus learned PPO residuals through capped motors; freely simulated body and contacts.
qualification: User-selected demo benchmark; walking torque gate not passed; no terrain/sensor/hardware qualification.
known_limits: Fixed transferred CAD masses/inertia with scaled mock geometry; production CAD fit/linkage unverified.
Flat ground, forward commands only, fixed dynamics/materials, single evaluation seed.
Simulator state observations; no deployed sensor/estimator pipeline.
Joint-time samples requesting >1.6 Nm are 4.44%/4.81%, above the 0.5% comparison gate.
Positive mechanical power is not battery consumption or a thermal model.
comparison_rule: Preserve this exact benchmark. Compare later candidates on identical commands/scenarios and report tracking, deck motion, slip, motor load and failures separately. Extend to command transitions, unseen terrain, realistic sensors and measured hardware; more updates or reward alone do not establish improvement.
